# Ronin Rescue

A lone ronin saves the Shogun's daughter from three robbers in a cedar forest.

## Characters
- "the woman in grey": a young East Asian woman with fair skin, long black hair pinned up with three jade hairpins, wearing a pale grey silk kimono with a silver obi.
- "the ronin": a lean man in his late thirties with a topknot and a scarred brow, wearing a faded indigo haori and dark hakama.
- "stocky bearded robber": a stocky man with a thick beard, wearing a ragged brown jacket, holding a short knife.
- "tall gaunt shaved-head robber": a tall, gaunt man with a shaved head, wearing a patched blue tunic, holding a wooden club.
- "young wiry spear robber": a young, wiry man, bare-chested under a straw cape, holding a bamboo spear.
